item.title: Mariota ruled out as Commanders turn to 7th-round rookie at QB
item.description: Marcus Mariota left Sunday's game against the Colts with a knee injury, forcing the Commanders to turn to seventh-round rookie Athan Kaliakmanis at quarterback.
item.dc:creator: John Keim

item.title: Schottenheimer owned up to Rio mistakes in meeting with Cowboys players
item.description: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer took accountability in the locker room for last Sunday's late-game loss to the Ravens.
item.dc:creator: Ian Rapoport

item.title: Brewers escape as Padres' potential go-ahead HR hits roof, falls for out
item.description: The Brewers eked out a Game 1 NLDS win after the American Family Field roof impeded what the Padres thought was going to be a go-ahead home run in the ninth inning.
item.dc:creator: Jesse Rogers

item.title: Sources: LaPorta, Lions break off contract talks after negotiations stall
item.description: The Lions and star tight end Sam LaPorta have broken off contract talks, sources told NFL Network, after attempting to work out a long-term deal for the first few weeks of the season.
item.dc:creator: Ian Rapoport

item.title: Sources: Mayfield out 3-6 weeks, depending on when QB can grip football
item.description: Baker Mayfield is expected to miss anywhere from three to six weeks, sources told ESPN, depending on how quickly the Buccaneers quarterback can grip the football.
item.dc:creator: Adam Schefter
